# AI Assistant Instructions - Yoga Flashcards

All AI coding assistant instructions are maintained in the CLAUDE.md files:

- `CLAUDE.md` -- Root project instructions (architecture, conventions, commands)
- `backend/CLAUDE.md` -- Backend-specific instructions (Django/DRF patterns)
- `frontend/CLAUDE.md` -- Frontend-specific instructions (Vue/Quasar patterns)

Refer to those files for all development guidance. Additional documentation:
- `docs/FUNCTIONAL_SPEC.md` -- Complete functional specification
- `docs/API_REFERENCE.md` -- API endpoint documentation
- `docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md` -- Database schema documentation
